turns.prompt_text: Good morning, today I have a lock to pick, where in Ankeny can I find an affordable lock smith?
turns.response_html:
Based on your request for affordable options in Ankeny to help with a lock, here are a few locksmith services. Most locksmiths in the area are mobile and will come to you, but there are also specific locations you can visit.

Affordable & Highly Rated Mobile Options

ShaunLock This is a strong candidate for affordability, with local discussions often highlighting their reasonable rates. They are a mobile-focused service based in Des Moines that covers Ankeny.

  • Pricing Insights: Past customers have mentioned lockout services in the $60–$70 range, which is competitive for the area.
  • Services: Offers residential, commercial, and automotive lockout services.
  • Availability: Open weekdays until 6:00 PM.

VIP Locksmith If you need assistance outside of standard business hours or want a quick comparison, this is a reliable 24/7 option. Reviewers frequently mention receiving quotes that were better than competitors.

  • Pricing Insights: Users have specifically noted "super fast service" and being "quoted a better price than other locksmiths."
  • Availability: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, making them a good choice for emergencies.
  • Services: Full mobile service for home and car lockouts.

Ankeny-Based Location

KeyMe Locksmiths Located directly in Ankeny inside the Menards store, this is primarily a key-copying kiosk that also offers a dispatch service for mobile locksmiths.

  • Location: Inside Menards on SE Delaware Ave.
  • Services: Key copying (self-service) and mobile lockout services (technician dispatch).
  • Note: While convenient for copies, verify the "upfront flat rate" for mobile lockout services over the phone first, as kiosk-dispatched services can sometimes vary in price compared to local independent locksmiths.

Local Recommendation: In addition to the above, Mike's Lock & Key is a frequently recommended local favorite known for "reasonable prices" and professional service in Ankeny, though they do not have a mapped location card available here. They are worth a quick search if you want another comparison.

For the most accurate quote, are you looking to pick a lock on a house, a car, or something else like a padlock?
